bagPolicy.summary: State Farm Arena allows bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6" and does not enforce a clear bag policy. All bags are subject to screening.
allowed: fashion backpacks smaller than 14" x 14" x 6"
prohibited: All bags larger than 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags accompanying a child are exempt from the size requirement but are subject to search.

parking.note: State Farm Arena lists five decks and lots, all within a 5-minute walk. It recommends reserving in advance through ParkMobile to guarantee a spot and the lowest price.
parking.summary: Five decks and lots within a 5-minute walk. Reserve through ParkMobile.
lots: State Farm Drive, 1 State Farm Dr (under a 1-minute walk)
Diamond Deck, 100 Lower Andrew Young International Dr (VIP)
Ruby Lot, 199 Alabama St SW (under a 3-minute walk)
Sapphire Deck, 127 Centennial Olympic Park Dr NW (under a 5-minute walk)
The CTR Garage, 103 Centennial Olympic Park Dr NW (under a 5-minute walk)

rideshare.note: For rideshare pickup, use the Centennial Yards parking garage. Exit through Gate 2, 4, or 5, cross Centennial Olympic Park Drive NW, and follow rideshare signs past The Irish Exit to the garage.

concessions.note: State Farm Arena offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, featuring local Atlanta favorites like Chick-fil-A, Dolo's Pizza Co., and J.R. Crickets. New offerings include a BBQ Smashburger and a Black Bean Burger, with a focus on quality, speed, and sustainability.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA accessible. Wheelchair seating on all levels. Elevators, ramps, and accessible restrooms.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office is next to Gate 2 on Centennial Olympic Park Drive, behind the ATLANTA letters. It's open only on event days, starting one hour before the event's door time. Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate 1 and Gate 2 are on Centennial Olympic Park Drive by the Box Office. Strollers are allowed but must be checked at the Guest Service Center inside Gate 1. Door times are listed on each event's detail page.
